info.title: M02 Academic Registry — PROPOSED, NOT FROZEN

RosterDTO.description: When subject_id is non-null, students contains ONLY pupils enrolled in that subject offering on that date. A timetable period must use this filtered roster.

to_date.description: Inclusive last date. Null means open-ended.

ErrorEnvelope.title: ErrorEnvelope
ErrorEnvelope.description: The body of every non-2xx response from every module. Frozen: adding a top-level property is a contract revision, never a per-module extension.

code.description: Stable machine-readable code. 401 unauthenticated/stale_auth, 403 action_denied, 404 object_inaccessible, 409 version_conflict/state_conflict, 422 validation_failed. 429 rate_limited (added in M01; response carries Retry-After).

message_key.description: Lookup key the frontend renders in English or Malayalam. Never user-facing prose.

request_id.description: Correlates the response with server logs and audit rows.

field_errors.description: Always present; empty array when there are none, so clients never branch on key absence.

field.description: Dotted path using wire field names, never ORM attribute names.
